column1: # EXPLORATORY CONFIGURATION, option (d). The FP8 70B judge on its PINNED h200-141 line,
# Q1 file b, with the deterministic echo strip of experiments/jury/echo_strip.py applied to
# every response before the judge sees it. The serving line is the pinned one and is
# recorded as pinned; what makes this exploratory is the input transform, which lands on
# every vote as input_transform together with echo_strip.py's SHA-256.
# READ THIS BEFORE QUOTING THE RESULT: at the specified 200 characters the strip changes
# 0 of the 483 items, because the restated class plants an 86 to 99 character quote and not
# a copied block. So this run scores the SAME BYTES as job 826010 and its value is a
# second, independent measurement of q1b on this judge, not a test of the strip. The strip
# is tested offline, in tests/test_echo_strip.py and experiments/jury/project_echo_strip.py.
# The h200-141 sits in partition gpu, whose wall ceiling is 3 hours.
